api.name: OpenRouter
api.billing: Your OpenRouter account, which routes to many model providers.

api.name: Ollama (on this computer)
api.billing: Nothing: the model runs on this computer.
api.note: Small local models often handle tool calls poorly. Use Test connection to check.

api.name: LM Studio (on this computer)
api.billing: Nothing: the model runs on this computer.
api.note: Small local models often handle tool calls poorly. Use Test connection to check.

api.name: Google Gemini
api.billing: Your Gemini API project in Google AI Studio, on its free or paid tier.
api.note: Use a Gemini API key from Google AI Studio. Signing in with a Google account is not offered: Google's terms forbid third-party access to the services behind Gemini CLI.

api.name: xAI (Grok)
api.note: A SuperGrok or X Premium plan is not used here; xAI's terms for using a plan from other apps are unclear, so only API keys are offered.

api.name: OpenCode (pay as you go)
api.billing: Your OpenCode account's credits. A key needs an account with billing details.
api.note: Only models OpenCode serves through Chat Completions work here. OpenCode's free models can be used only inside OpenCode; for those, connect OpenCode as an agent app instead.

api.name: Custom endpoint
api.note: Any server that speaks OpenAI Chat Completions or the Anthropic Messages API.

runtimes.name: Codex (ChatGPT plan)
runtimes.billing: Your ChatGPT plan, through your own Codex sign-in.
runtimes.conversations: Codex keeps its own transcript of each chat in its sessions folder. Deleting the chat in Quantarium can remove it.
runtimes.terms: OpenAI supports using a ChatGPT plan through the Codex CLI.
runtimes.install: Install the Codex CLI and sign in with your ChatGPT plan, then restart Quantarium.

runtimes.name: Claude Code (Claude plan)
runtimes.billing: Whatever your own Claude Code is signed in with: a Claude plan or an API key.
runtimes.conversations: Claude Code keeps its own transcript of each chat in its projects folder. Deleting the chat in Quantarium can remove it.
runtimes.terms: Anthropic's terms allow signing in to the unmodified Claude Code with your own plan. Quantarium runs your installed Claude Code as it is and never sees your Claude sign-in. Anthropic has not confirmed this use for open-source apps, so it is experimental.
runtimes.install: Install Claude Code and sign in with claude, then restart Quantarium.
runtimes.acknowledgement: I choose to connect my own Claude Code to Quantarium. I have read Anthropic's terms, and any action Anthropic takes on my account because of this use is my own responsibility, not Quantarium's or its authors'.

runtimes.name: OpenCode
runtimes.billing: Whatever OpenCode is set up to use: its free models, OpenCode credits, or the providers you connected in OpenCode.
runtimes.conversations: OpenCode keeps its own record of each session in its data folder.
runtimes.terms: OpenCode's free models are offered only inside OpenCode; here they run in your own OpenCode. Providers you connected in OpenCode follow their own terms.
runtimes.install: Install OpenCode, run it once to choose a model or connect a provider, then restart Quantarium.

runtimes.name: Custom ACP agent
runtimes.billing: Whatever the agent app is set up to use.
runtimes.conversations: The agent app may keep its own record of each chat.
runtimes.terms: Check the agent app's own terms, and its provider's, before using a subscription through it.
runtimes.install: Any app that speaks the Agent Client Protocol on stdio, such as opencode acp.
